title: The Psychosocial Impacts of Generative AI Harms

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing LM-generated educational stories prompted with open-ended classroom scenarios to identify patterns of representational harms (erasure, subordination, and stereotyping). The evaluation quantifies name-race associations (e.g., 'Maria' for Latine, 'Priya' for Asian, 'Sarah' for White) and explicit demographic mentions (e.g., 'Native American') to measure disparities in academic achievement portrayals, subject matter placement, and social roles.

Examining intersectional representational harms by specifically filtering for and comparing characters with highly feminized names across different academic disciplines (STEM vs. Humanities and Social Sciences) and measuring how gender interacts with racial stereotypes in the generated text.
